metadata.description: Face off against the most powerful yakuza in the Kansai region of Japan, "Dragon of Kansai" Ryuji Goda, as the legendary man once known as the "Dragon of Dojima", Kazuma Kiryu. A fierce battle to determine the one true dragon begins. Unleash devastating combos, brutal 'heat action' moves, and dynamic environmental takedowns with Yakuza Kiwami 2’s full-contact brawling action. Every blow hits like a ton of bricks with intuitive controls that make it easy for anyone to feel the thrill of realistic and strategic street fights where anything goes. Take a break from busting heads to enjoy all the activities that Japan's leading entertainment districts have to offer. Kamurocho is home to a variety of restaurants, bars, and experiences made to satisfy the endless desires of visitors. Sotenbori welcomes all with its deeply rooted culture of food and laughter. Whether you're into karaoke or cabaret, batting cages or blackjack, there's something for everyone. A bonus ”Majima Saga” scenario, separate from the main story is also included. Discover the untold saga of what takes place between the events of Yakuza Kiwami and Yakuza Kiwami 2 as Goro Majima. *If you have the PS4® digital download version of Yakuza Kiwami 2, you can get the PS5® digital download version of Yakuza Kiwami 2 at no cost. This offer does not apply to the PlayStation Plus PS4® digital download or physical versions of Yakuza Kiwami 2. *The PS5® version of Yakuza Kiwami 2 adds additional text languages not supported in the PS4® version of Yakuza Kiwami 2. There are no other differences in the basic game content or specifications. *The PS4® version of Yakuza Kiwami 2 only supports Japanese voice and English and Japanese text. *Save data from Yakuza Kiwami 2 for PS4® does not carry over to Yakuza Kiwami 2 for PS5®.
